entries.final_answer: Operator rulings (confirmed 2026-10-20): 1) name spec-kitty-<cmd>, one naming authority constant, uniqueness check vs built-in charter skills and RETIRED_CANONICAL_SKILL_NAMES, orphan detection keyed on manifest/explicit command set never the prefix. 2) Clean break: migration renames installed skills (install new, remove manifest-owned unmodified spec-kitty.<cmd>/, keep hand-edited with warning, rewrite manifest keys, idempotent, config-aware, never mkdir, order_manifest entry); release note + init/upgrade banner; doctor skills flags leftover dotted dirs; 13 command-agent slash-command files out of scope (#6471). 3) Antigravity: stop .agent/workflows project+global; migration removes owned spec-kitty.*.md from project .agent/workflows (never dir, never foreign); global writer stops writing ~/.agent/workflows, removes only owned files there on startup, stops fanning out to unconfigured agents. 4) Spec-conformant frontmatter per target, name<=64 description<=1024, skills-ref validator in CI. 5) open-packs PR replacing /spec-kitty.<cmd> and $spec-kitty. invocations, then pin bump. Red-first p0_repro tests; new ADR amending 2026-04-07-1; stop and ask on uncovered cases.
